topPRs.title: feat(template): add SetFeeVaultConfig for in-place fee-vault config updates
topPRs.author: donoso-eth
topPRs.body:
## Summary

Adds a reusable `SetFeeVaultConfig` template that updates the on-chain config
(recipient / withdrawalNetwork / minWithdrawalAmount) of one or more L2 fee-vault
predeploys **in place**, via the vaults' own owner-gated setters
(`setRecipient` / `setWithdrawalNetwork` / `setMinWithdrawalAmount`), sent as
`OptimismPortal2.depositTransaction` from the L1 ProxyAdminOwner. No proxy upgrade,
no re-initialize. Chain-specific values come from `config.toml`.

## Why

The existing fee-vault templates change the recipient by **upgrading the impl**
(`UpdateFeeVaultRecipient` installs a new immutable impl; `FeeVaultUpgradeTemplate`
migrates to the storage design via `initialize`). Once a chain's vaults are already on the
storage design (e.g. OP Sepolia / Ink Mainnet: L1FeeVault v1.6.1, OperatorFeeVault v1.1.1),
re-running `FeeVaultUpgradeTemplate` reverts (`InvalidInitialization`) and would downgrade
the impl. On those chains recipient/network/min are mutable storage with owner-gated
setters, so a plain setter call is the correct, minimal mechanism — which is what this
template provides.

### Files

- **`src/template/SetFeeVaultConfig.sol`** — `L2TaskBase` template; emits one portal
  deposit per *changed* field across the configured `vaultProxies`.
- **`test/tasks/example/sep/041-set-fee-vault-config/`** — example task (OP Sepolia:
  L1FeeVault + OperatorFeeVault → shared recipient, WithdrawalNetwork.L1).
- **`test/integration/SetFeeVaultConfigIntegration.t.sol`** — end-to-end test; forks
  L1 + OP Sepolia, replays the setter deposits, asserts the vault config changed. Reuses
  `IntegrationBase`.

### Validation

- **Capability/version gate** — rejects vaults below the min version that exposes the
  setters (Sequencer/Base/L1 ≥ 1.6.0, Operator ≥ 1.1.1); old immutable vaults must use
  `FeeVaultUpgradeTemplate` first.
- **Required `l2RpcUrls` preflight** — asserts `L2 ProxyAdmin.owner() == aliased root`,
  enforces the version gate, and **dry-runs the setters** as the aliased owner so an L2
  revert surfaces at setup instead of silently on relay.
- **Per-field skip-unchanged** — only fields that differ from live state produce a deposit;
  at least one must change (else the framework reverts "No actions found").
- **`_validate`** — asserts action count + every action targets the OptimismPortal, value 0.
- Non-zero recipient, `network <= 1`, and known-vault checks.

## Test plan

- [x] `forge test --match-test test_setFeeVaultConfig_integration -vvv` — 1/1 passed (4/4 deposits succeed; recipient/network/min verified on the OP Sepolia fork)
- [x] `just simulate` on `sep/041` — `SETFEEVAULTCONFIG: VALIDATED PORTAL DEPOSIT ACTIONS`
- [x] `forge build --deny-warnings` — clean
- [x] `forge fmt --check` — clean
- [x] `./src/script/check-struct-order.sh` — clean

## Self-review (template-review checklist)

Ran the internal template-review checklist; **0 blocking findings**. Minor items resolved:
inline interfaces (`IOptimismPortal2`/`IProxyAdminView`/`IVersioned`), `vm.label`s, corrected
NatSpec (the "No actions found" behavior + skip-unchanged sign-time semantics), removed an
unused import, `Supports:` line added. `_taskStorageWrites = ["OptimismPortalProxy"]`
cross-checked against the sim state diff.

> [!IMPORTANT]
> **Escalation:** this is a **new template type** and performs a **cross-layer** operation
> (L1→L2 portal deposits driving L2 setter calls) — flagged for **Security-team review** per
> the template-review checklist.

## Notes

- Additive: does not modify `UpdateFeeVaultRecipient` or `FeeVaultUpgradeTemplate`.
- No `Regression.t.sol` entry: per-field skip-unchanged reads live L2 state, so a
  hardcoded-calldata regression test would be non-deterministic. The `sep/041` example is
  covered by CI's `simulate-all-templates`, and the integration test covers the end-to-end
  L2 effect — matching the sibling `UpdateFeeVaultRecipient`, which likewise has no
  regression test.
